name: mochicode-auto
description: Keep stock-quality Sol direct and add proven Luna workers, bounded fan-out, or selective evidence gates only when their overhead is justified.

interface.longDescription: Preserves stock Sol High behavior for substantive and small sequential work, uses a real Luna Medium child only for sizable independent implementation leaves that can repay delegation overhead, permits small Sol-led fan-out only for frozen disjoint leaves, and activates durable state or fresh-context judges only when their measured trigger applies. Model claims require session evidence or child receipts, and the deterministic controller remains an explicit unpromoted experiment.
defaultPrompt: Complete this goal using the smallest quality-proven automatic route.
Keep stock Sol behavior unless a proven worker route clearly repays its overhead.
Use selective workers, state, and judges only when their trigger is present.
